status_meanings.NATIVE_AUDITED: Relevant current native WordPress/platform possibilities have been exhaustively audited and classified.

status_meanings.BANK_REVIEWED: Native + market + WPE-future possibilities are reviewed; duplicates/gaps are resolved and the surface Bank is ready to feed implementation contracts.
